# Admin Sales Report - Sheet Generation by Report Type

## Report Types Available:
1. **`all`** - All reports (includes everything)
2. **`events`** or **`tickets`** - Event/Ticket sales reports
3. **`subscriptions`** - Subscription reports
4. **`additional_tickets`** - Additional ticket purchases reports
5. **`payouts`** - Payout reports

## Sheets Generated by Report Type:

### 1. **`all`** (All Reports)
**Always Included:**
- ✅ **Summary** - Overview of all revenue types (tickets, subscriptions, additional tickets)
- ✅ **Invoice Summary** - Combined invoice data from all types

**Conditional Sheets (all included):**
- ✅ **Events** - Event summary with total sales and net value per event
- ✅ **Ticket Sales** - Detailed ticket purchase records from ticket_purchases table
- ✅ **Subscription Sales** - Subscription purchase details
- ✅ **Additional Tickets Details** - Additional ticket purchase records
- ✅ **Payouts** - Payout request details

**Total: 7 sheets**

---

### 2. **`events`** or **`tickets`** (Event/Ticket Sales)
**Always Included:**
- ✅ **Summary** - Event sales summary only
- ✅ **Invoice Summary** - Invoice data (tickets only)

**Conditional Sheets:**
- ✅ **Events** - Event summary with total sales and net value per event
- ✅ **Ticket Sales** - Detailed ticket purchase records

**Total: 4 sheets**

---

### 3. **`subscriptions`** (Subscription Reports)
**Always Included:**
- ✅ **Summary** - Subscription sales summary only
- ✅ **Invoice Summary** - Invoice data (subscriptions only)

**Conditional Sheets:**
- ✅ **Subscription Sales** - Subscription purchase details

**Total: 3 sheets**

---

### 4. **`additional_tickets`** (Additional Ticket Purchases)
**Always Included:**
- ✅ **Summary** - Additional tickets summary only
- ✅ **Invoice Summary** - Invoice data (additional tickets only)

**Conditional Sheets:**
- ✅ **Additional Tickets Details** - Additional ticket purchase records

**Total: 3 sheets**

---

### 5. **`payouts`** (Payout Reports)
**Always Included:**
- ✅ **Summary** - Summary (may not include payout summary if no payout data in summary)
- ✅ **Invoice Summary** - Invoice data (empty if no other types included)

**Conditional Sheets:**
- ✅ **Payouts** - Payout request details

**Total: 2-3 sheets** (depending on summary data)

---

## Sheet Details:

### **Summary Sheet**
- Always the first sheet
- Contains aggregated revenue data based on included types
- Shows: Gross Revenue, Net Revenue, Orders, etc.

### **Events Sheet** (if `events` or `tickets` or `all`)
- Event ID, Event Title, Event Date, Event Status
- Organizer name
- Total Sales (Gross), Net Value
- Transaction Fees, VAT Amount, Total Fees
- Total Orders, Paid Orders
- Average Order Value
- First Sale Date, Last Sale Date

### **Ticket Sales Sheet** (if `events` or `tickets` or `all`)
- Purchase ID, Buyer, Email
- Event Title, Ticket Type, Status
- Quantity, Total Amount (Gross)
- Transaction Fee, VAT Amount, Net Amount
- Payment Method
- Created At, Paid At

### **Subscription Sales Sheet** (if `subscriptions` or `all`)
- Subscription ID, Customer, Email
- Plan name, Amount
- Status, Payment Status
- Start Date, End Date

### **Additional Tickets Details Sheet** (if `additional_tickets` or `all`)
- Purchase ID, Customer, Email
- Plan name, Quantity
- Gross Amount, Net Amount
- Paid At

### **Payouts Sheet** (if `payouts` or `all`)
- Payout ID, Event, Organizer
- Status, Gross Amount, Net Amount
- Processed At

### **Invoice Summary Sheet**
- Always included
- Combines data from all included types
- Shows: Type, Customer, Email, Item, Quantity, Gross, Net, Paid At
